summary: Form 6-K filed by SOL Strategies Inc. (Canadian issuer, NASDAQ-listed) reporting a press release announcing a partnership between its subsidiary Houdini Swap and pump.fun's Terminal trading platform. The integration enables private deposits/withdrawals for traders. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, restructuring, spin-off, liquidation, delisting, rights offering, capital return (buyback/dividend), deal termination, SPAC, activist campaign, strategic review, or forced management change (CEO appointment is routine) is discussed. This is a routine business-development press release, not a special situation event.
